notes: Introduced a premium UI overhaul with a dynamic animated Splash Screen, a luxurious full-screen Dashboard background, custom overscroll branding animations, and improved Quick Actions routing. Additionally, completely redesigned the Login and Forgot Password screens with centered, industry-level aesthetics and brand icons. Also resolved Android 12+ adaptive splash icon cutoff issues and fixed Dashboard layout overflow bugs for better responsiveness.
